messages.author: ec0ca9b456d87384
messages.subject: question about pos.file
parts:
Hi, Robbie.
I found that when I give a pos.file(SNP from region chr1:1-2000000) and region(chr1 regionStart:7000000 regionEnd:10000000) to STITCH,  and I get the result, and the result is from region: chr1:7000000-10000000. So what's the role of pos.file? 
Looking forward to your replay. Thank you.

messages.author: aa7b5c73c3a6760a
messages.subject: Re: question about pos.file
parts:
Hi,

The posfile specifies a list of (putative) bi-allelic SNPs for that chromosome (or region) that STITCH is to operate over. regionStart and regionEnd specify specifically where on that chromosome you want imputation to operate (note they can be left at default to run the whole chromosome). 

The intention is that generally posfile would be prepared per-chromosome, and regionStart/regionEnd/buffer set depending on RAM / number of samples / computational capacity. So for example you can prepare posfile per chromosome and then run in 2Mbp chunks or 5Mbp chunks, but the later always uses the same posfile.

Best,
Robbie
